Name: DE-Descriptions
Description: Extracts the different versions of the descriptions of documents.
Statement:
select  Oid as DescriptionId,
        PlainText as Description,
        Text as DescriptionHtml,
        Version,
        max(Version) over (partition by DocumentOid) as LatestVersion,
        iif(Version = max(Version) over (partition by DocumentOid), 1, 0) as IsLastVersion,
        DocumentOid as DocumentId,
        DocumentTypeName as Document,
        CreatedOn,
        cre.Id as CreatedById,
        cre.Name as CreatedBy,
        des.EditedOn as ModifiedOn
from    DocumentBrief des
            join UserLookup cre on cre.Id = des.CreatedBy
